entities.name: Dean Moseo
entities.description: Owlin skeleton warlock and osteomancer, teacher and Dean of the Vein at Witherbloom College.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven University where Moseo teaches.

events.summary: Nearly compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion, Moseo casts a spell purging the corruption, leaving him an animated skeleton.
events.quote: he cast a dangerous spell that purged the Phyrexian corruption from his body

events.summary: After Valentin's death, Moseo assumes the role of Dean of the Vein.
events.quote: Moseo chose to assume the role of Dean of the Vein following Valentin 's death
